title: Plots & a Performance Profiler
summary: Graph frame times from a ring buffer, show min/avg/max and a budget bar, pin a transparent HUD to a screen corner and time code sections with QueryPerformanceCounter.

quiz.q: You plot the ring buffer gFrameTimes. What should you pass as values_offset so the newest sample is on the right?
quiz.explain: The plot starts drawing at values_offset and wraps around. The next write slot holds the oldest value, so the newest one ends up at the right edge.

quiz.q: With VSync on, your frame time sits at 16.7 ms even with an empty scene. Why?
options: SwapBuffers waits for the monitor refresh, so you measure the refresh interval
The ring buffer is too short
quiz.explain: Turn VSync off (gVSync = false) to see the real cost of a frame.

quiz.q: In SetNextWindowPos(pos, ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(1, 1)), what does the last argument do?
options: It is the pivot: the window's bottom-right corner is placed at pos
quiz.explain: The pivot lets you anchor a window by any of its corners without knowing its size, which is ideal for corner HUDs.
